title: Season Ticket
summary: A soccer club management game set in Valmere, a made-up northern country. Own a club in the 16-team Kestrel Football League: run the business from your own 3D office, build the squad and the stadium, and change tactics while you watch the match. Play a whole career, on your phone, even offline.

The same ground at night

title: Scrapline
summary: A combat robot builder. Design a fighting robot under a weight limit, test it on the bench, drive it in the arena, patch it in the pit and read the post-mortem, from a plywood box in a rented corner of a machine shop to the televised Scrapline Open.
latest: A balance pass on flippers, drums, lifters and the small-class pits

Two robots trading hits beside the pit

title: Lombard
summary: A first-person pawn shop sim on a canal in Mostograd, a made-up Russian river city in the 2010s. Inspect what people bring in, spot the fakes, haggle, and decide how much trouble a good deal is worth.
latest: A pawn-ticket loading screen and a home screen icon

title: Frontier Lab
summary: An AI-lab tycoon. Raise a seed round, open sales offices, buy compute or build data centers, train your own models and ship products, keep the safety regulator happy, then take the lab public and grow it across the world's tech capitals, all on an engraved isometric city map.
latest: A loading screen from the very first moment

title: Red Skies
summary: A phone game where you run an air-defence battery. Watch the radar, sort friendly jets from enemies, and hold your fire until you're sure, because shooting down a friendly ends the shift.

title: Ink
summary: A tattoo artist career game set in Mostograd. Start as an apprentice sweeping floors, learn on fake skin, build a client list and open your own studio, with every piece aging on people who keep walking back through your door.

title: Station Keeper
summary: A space station tycoon. Build a commercial station module by module and keep it alive, solvent and full of paying guests. Power, cooling, air, crew and money all share one network, so when one thing fails, the rest follow.
latest: A home screen icon and a proper loading screen

title: The Whip
summary: A political career game for your phone. Start as a rookie backbench MP in the 120-seat House of Commons of the made-up Dominion of Caledor and climb to Chief Whip: the person who counts the votes, makes the deals and gets the caucus into the chamber when it matters. Every MP remembers what you promised.
latest: Fully playable: the whole career, from rookie MP to Chief Whip

title: Pre-market brief
summary: Every weekday before the open, a short read on MU and the AI hardware names: overnight moves, the gap call, key levels and the day's calendar, written from the morning's news.

title: AI Trading Journal
summary: My market views, the trades I take, and my running record, with notes from an AI coach on what to keep doing and what to fix.

title: Agent Fleet
summary: A set of small, single-purpose bots I can run from my phone, like news digests, trackers, and weekly scans.
